_about: Traits that make a screen look like every other generated screen, used by scripts/lint_ui.py as warnings only. They describe what machine-made pages tend to share as of the date written; fashions move, so review the list when it is more than six months old. A brief that asks for one of these wins. A pattern with "min" warns only when it appears at least that many times in one file.

max_rounds.unit: render-and-inspect rounds before the work stops and asks

value.what: an indigo-to-violet gradient, the most common generated accent
a font family most generated pages use
frosted glass panels
emoji used as icons in markup
gradient-filled headline text
hero copy words that fit any product
a row of three equal feature cards
very large corner radius on every block
coloured glow shadows
a blue-to-violet gradient, the reverse of the usual generated accent
the framework's stock indigo or violet used as the brand colour

value.pattern: unlock the (full )?power|harness the power|take your \w+( \w+)? to the next level|transform the way you|built for the modern|your all-in-one|the all-in-one|like never before|say goodbye to|streamline your|effortless(ly)? (manage|create|build)|the future of \w+ is here
value.what: hero phrases that could sell any product
a small pill badge announcing something new above the headline
a sparkle icon standing in for AI or magic
large blurred colour blobs behind the content
grey text on a saturated colour, which reads muddy
bouncing or pinging decoration that pulls the eye for no reason
every card lifts or grows on hover
a small spaced capital label above every section
gradient-filled buttons

value.pattern: >\s*(get started( for free| now| today)?|learn more|start (your )?free trial|try it (for )?free|start for free)\s*(→|→)?\s*<
value.what: calls to action that say nothing about this product

patterns.unit: regular expressions matched per line, case-insensitive
patterns.source: mstack's own observation of generated pages, written 2026-11-22; extended 2026-11-25

same-card-everywhere.what: the same rounded, shadowed card class repeated block after block

icon-tile-grid.what: a grid of square icon tiles, each over a heading

uniform-card-copy.what: cards whose titles have the same word count and whose texts are nearly the same length

font-weight-sprawl.what: more font weights than a type scale needs

skipped-heading.what: a heading level is skipped (for example h1 straight to h3)
